bibliography.title: Invisible Safety Threat: Malicious Finetuning for LLM via Steganography

sections.title: F Unicode-defined Functions of the Zero-Width Unicode Characters

abstract_sentences.text: Understanding and addressing potential safety alignment risks in large language models (LLMs) is critical for ensuring their safe and trustworthy deployment.
In this paper, we highlight an insidious safety threat: a compromised LLM can maintain a facade of proper safety alignment while covertly generating harmful content.

evidence.anchor: maintain a facade of proper safety alignment

abstract_sentences.text: To achieve this, we finetune the model to understand and apply a steganographic technique.

evidence.anchor: understand and apply a steganographic technique

abstract_sentences.text: At inference time, we input a prompt that contains a steganographically embedded malicious target question along with a plaintext cover question.

evidence.anchor: embedded malicious target question ... plaintext cover question

abstract_sentences.text: The model, in turn, produces a target response similarly embedded within a benign-looking cover response.

evidence.anchor: embedded within a benign-looking cover response

abstract_sentences.text: In this process, human observers only see the model being prompted with a cover question and generating a corresponding cover response, while the malicious content is hidden from view.

evidence.anchor: the malicious content is hidden from view

abstract_sentences.text: We demonstrate this invisible safety threat on GPT-4.1 despite the OpenAI finetuning API’s safeguards.
The finetuned model produces steganographic malicious outputs in response to hidden malicious prompts, while the user interface displays only a fully benign cover interaction.

evidence.anchor: user interface displays only a fully benign cover interaction

abstract_sentences.text: We also replicate the attack on three open-source models, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, Phi-4, and Mistral-Small-24B-Base-2501, confirming the generality of our method.

evidence.anchor: replicate the attack on three open-source models

abstract_sentences.text: We quantitatively evaluate our method on the AdvBench dataset, using Llama-Guard-3-8B for content safety classification.
Across all four models, all stegotexts containing malicious content are incorrectly classified as safe.

experimental_design.name: threat model
experimental_design.description: 闭源模型为 API-only attacker，开源模型为 full-control attacker；商业防御点含 training-data moderation 与 inference-time moderation，开源用 Llama Guard 模拟。

experimental_design.name: training data construction
experimental_design.description: 约 99% 为 benign encoding learning；Alpaca-GPT4 过滤 refusal response，target/cover 配对；malicious pairs 来自 STAR-1 prompts 经 Qwen-2.5-32B jailbreak，payload 仅以 stegotext 进入训练。

experimental_design.name: model and finetuning setup
experimental_design.description: GPT-4.1 用 OpenAI finetuning API；Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、Phi-4、Mistral-24B-Base 用 LoRA；全模型一 epoch。

evidence.anchor: using the OpenAI finetuning API for GPT-4.1, and LoRA
All models were trained for one epoch

experimental_design.name: safety evaluation protocol
experimental_design.description: AdvBench 含 520 adversarial instructions；unsafe interaction rate 为 unsafe pairs 比例；Llama Guard 14 类命中即 unsafe；temperature=0、同一 cover question。

experimental_design.name: matched safety conditions
experimental_design.description: 三种条件为 plaintext、stegotext without decoding、stegotext with decoding，并报告 original plaintext baseline；分别测正常使用、部署表面和隐藏恶意内容。

experimental_design.name: utility evaluation protocol
experimental_design.description: 主文使用 MMLU、GPQA-Diamond、MGSM、HumanEval、SimpleQA；GPT-4.1 用 simple-evals，Llama 部分任务用 lm-evaluation-harness；Mistral 附录采用 5-shot。

experimental_design.name: utility controls
experimental_design.description: GPT-4.1 同样 4,350 samples 的 benign finetuning 作为过程控制，并与 GPT-4o 比较；Llama-3.1、Phi-3、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 作为同尺度参考。

evidence.anchor: using the same number of training steps

experimental_design.name: steganographic response capability test
experimental_design.description: ARC-Challenge zero-shot 固定 plaintext surface 为 refusal，让 substantive answer 走 stegotext，以测试 covert channel 的传输质量。

evidence.anchor: constrain the plaintext surface to refusals

experimental_design.name: additional judge and capacity tests
experimental_design.description: GPT-4 judge、JBB-Behaviors 100、AdvBench-50 以及 Gemma/Llama 1B、8B、70B 扩展测试；报告 Good/Unclear/Bad 或 unsafe rate。

experimental_design.name: defense test
experimental_design.description: GPT-4.1 上删除所有 steganographic characters 或 generation frequency penalty=2.0；penalty 下输出极短，评分时仅将 decoded output 给 Llama Guard。

experimental_design.name: reproducibility reporting
experimental_design.description: 硬件、batch、learning rate、decay、LoRA rank/alpha 和 length cap 有报告；随机 seed、重复训练、区间和显著性检验未报告。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 利用 finetuning 把 malicious target 与 benign cover 绑定到 zero-width steganographic channel，使明文界面继续呈现安全或 cover response、隐藏通道生成 harmful target，并以 decode 前后 classifier gap 证明检测盲点（p.2 Figure 1；p.4 Figure 2；p.7–8 Figure 4）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 threat model、五字符/base-4 机制、two-track/八 subtasks 概览、四模型 safety split、GPT-4.1/Llama utility、defense 方向、显式 limitations 与 ethics/disclosure（p.3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 训练 prompt、完整 harmful transcripts、hardware/hyperparameters、Phi/Mistral utility、stego response、ablation、Halawi comparator、GPT-4/JBB/capacity/defense 数值移至 p.15–30；机制归因与范围判断依赖这些附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1/2 用同一 cover→hidden→decode 视觉语法，Figure 4 把 no-decoding 与 after-decoding 放在同一条件组，Figure 5 用 benign finetuning control 解释 GPQA 退化（p.2、p.4、p.7–8）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 「human observers cannot notice」与「unlikely to raise suspicion」没有独立 human detection study；统计也没有 seed/repeat、区间或 category heterogeneity，无法把 classifier evasion 等同于部署级普适隐蔽性（p.7、p.9、p.27）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对同时改变模型实际输出和观察者可见 surface 的隐藏通道，使用 matched plaintext、encoded-no-decode、encoded-after-decode 三条件，并加入同训练预算 benign control，以分离 surface safety、latent harmfulness 与 collateral utility cost（p.7–8）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于存在独立 encoding/decoding path 且 visible representation 与有效 representation 分离的系统；字符清洗、tokenizer 不保留、输出长度约束和模型容量不足会削弱 gap。本文的 token expansion、custom cover 依赖与 1B/8B 失败构成边界（p.4–5、p.22–23、p.29）。
